lines: The Safe Room reminds you: the show is live, and so are you.
Mile High Recovery Solutions is not a hospital. Please stop asking.
Tonight's floor is sponsored by whoever is still paying.
If you can read this, you are close enough to be on camera.
The house keeps a little. The house has always kept a little.
Climbing without a rope is a choice. So is reading the sign.
Dead air is still air. Do not stand in it.
Gate Run starts when the gate says so, not when you do.
